title: Legal evidence + owner adoption register
decision: Owner decision, 6 October 2026 (GS-LEGAL-001): no solicitor is commissioned at this stage; GS-O003's mandatory solicitor approval is replaced by an evidence-based review of each document against current UK legislation and official guidance, followed by explicit owner adoption. Nothing in this register claims solicitor review, certification or guaranteed enforceability.
rules: Only the owner moves a document to OWNER_ADOPTED, by recording ownerAdoptedOn (date) and ownerAdoptedVersion (the exact version adopted). No script sets either.
PUBLISHABLE requires OWNER_ADOPTED plus a passing check:legal:adoption run on the adopted version; ownerAdoptedVersion must equal the document's version.
scripts/migrate-production-cms.mjs admits a legal document to the production payload only at PUBLISHABLE.

An adopted entry records adoptionAuthority (the owner's instruction) and its publicationPrerequisites; PUBLISHABLE is refused while any prerequisite has no recorded evidence in prerequisitesMet. Adoption is never inferred: a document carrying an open marker cannot be OWNER_ADOPTED.
stateRecord: 6 October 2026 (GS-LEGAL-001): all seven moved to OWNER_REVIEW_REQUIRED on Agent G's re-verification (research/GS-LEGAL-001/G-final-cross-check.md section 7). 7 October 2026 (GS-LEGAL-001-R3): the owner decisions in research/GS-LEGAL-001/R2-OWNER-DECISION-PACK.md section 4 were applied (research/GS-LEGAL-001/R3-OWNER-DECISIONS-APPLIED.md); the client terms for consumers and for business clients moved to version 3.1, the other five are unchanged; all seven remain OWNER_REVIEW_REQUIRED, and six of them now need only the owner's adoption. The privacy policy still carries three [OWNER DECISION] markers (processor terms, transfer safeguard, retention) that wait on owner account checks and on the retention routine operating, so it is not adoptable. No document is OWNER_ADOPTED. 7 October 2026 (GS-LEGAL-001-R4): on the owner's instruction, six documents are OWNER_ADOPTED (business-client-terms 3.1, consumer-client-terms 3.1, terms 2.1, cookies 2.1, accessibility 2.1, client-terms 2.1), each with its publication prerequisites listed and none met; none is PUBLISHABLE. The privacy policy is not adopted and remains OWNER_REVIEW_REQUIRED with its three markers (research/GS-LEGAL-001/R4-OWNER-ADOPTION.md).
